-- ../../../modules/s3_0a1b2c3d/main.tf --
resource "aws_s3_bucket" "this" {
  bucket        = var.bucket
  force_destroy = var.force_destroy
  tags          = var.tags
}

resource "aws_s3_bucket_versioning" "versioning" {
  bucket = aws_s3_bucket.this.id

  versioning_configuration {
    status = var.versioning_versioning_configuration_status
  }
}
-- ../../../modules/s3_0a1b2c3d/variables.tf --
variable "bucket" {
  type = string
}

variable "tags" {
  type = map(string)
}

variable "versioning_versioning_configuration_status" {
  type = string
}

variable "force_destroy" {
  description = "The force_destroy of aws_s3_bucket.this, the same for every call that doesn't set it."
  type        = bool
  default     = false
}
-- main.tf --
module "logs" {
  source = "../../../modules/s3_0a1b2c3d"

  bucket = "logs"
  tags = {
    Env = "prod"
  }
  versioning_versioning_configuration_status = "Enabled"
  force_destroy                              = true
}

module "data" {
  source = "../../../modules/s3_0a1b2c3d"

  bucket = "data"
  tags = {
    Env = "prod"
  }
  versioning_versioning_configuration_status = "Enabled"
}
